sections.title: Molecular profile of endometrioid carcinoma
sections.intro: Serous is the most molecularly homogeneous histotype. **Endometrioid is the least:** all four classes occur in substantial proportions, and they differ from each other in prognosis and treatment benefit more than grade does.

notes.title: Early-stage endometrioid: radiotherapy buys local control, not survival
notes.md: PORTEC-1, GOG-99 and ASTEC/EN.5 all cut locoregional recurrence without an OS gain, and ASTEC's meta-analysis rules out an OS benefit of more than 3%. PORTEC-1 adds two points: vaginal relapse is salvageable (2-yr survival 79%, vs 21% after pelvic or distant relapse), and survival after relapse was *better* without upfront RT. PORTEC-2 then showed VBT gives the same vaginal control as EBRT with far less GI toxicity. Together these support observation for low-risk disease and VBT for HIR disease.

notes.title: Histology-defined high-risk trials hide a molecular split
notes.md: About 71% of PORTEC-3 patients had endometrioid tumours, but the chemotherapy benefit sits in p53abn. MMRd — the largest endometrioid class — gained nothing from chemotherapy (10-yr RFS HR 1.13). "High-risk endometrioid, add chemo?" therefore has no single answer: p53abn yes, MMRd no, POLEmut probably not needed, NSMP depends on ER. The KEYNOTE-B21 dMMR result (HR 0.31) points the MMRd group toward immunotherapy but comes from a trial that failed its primary endpoint, so it is hypothesis-generating only. B21 also enrolled stage I–II endometrioid only if p53abn, so **stage I–II NSMP/MMRd endometrioid is not represented in any adjuvant immunotherapy data.** JGOG-2033 is the only endometrioid-only randomized adjuvant trial here reported on its own (MaNGO ILIADE-III was also endometrioid-only but is published pooled with NSGO/EORTC). Its chemotherapy-favouring HIR result is a subgroup analysis, and CAP is no longer used.

notes.title: Three interpretation traps
notes.md:
- **dMMR HRs apply to endometrioid; pMMR HRs do not.** The dMMR benefit is consistent across four trials (HR 0.28–0.42) and dMMR is effectively an endometrioid population. The pMMR HRs (0.54–0.92) average NSMP endometrioid with p53abn serous and carcinosarcoma, and no trial here separates them.
- **DUO-E endometrioid event rates are not HRs.** Progression fell 66.2% → 50.4% → 48.7% across control, durvalumab and D+O. Olaparib adds little visible effect in endometrioid tumours, but a clear one in serous (70.7% → 57.1%). That fits olaparib's pMMR-only effect and the dMMR enrichment of endometrioid tumours. Fig 3A/3B endometrioid PFS HRs vs control are **0.65 (0.47–0.88)** for durvalumab and **0.54 (0.40–0.74)** for D+O (serous 0.71 → 0.46), but they are unstratified exploratory subgroup HRs against control, not a D+O vs durvalumab comparison — treat as hypothesis-consistent only.
- **GOG-209 established carbo/taxol by non-inferiority, not superiority.** The grade 1 HR 0.58 is one cell of a forest plot. It is also a reminder that low-grade, receptor-positive endometrioid disease has a non-cytotoxic first-line option (Table 3A).

sections.title: 3. Recurrent disease
sections.intro: Recurrent disease is **not one setting**. The GOG trials treated recurrence with first-line cytotoxic therapy in patients who had never had chemotherapy; the modern trials treat recurrence after platinum and, increasingly, after a checkpoint inhibitor. For endometrioid carcinoma there is a third axis the serous note does not need: **hormonal therapy**, whose activity depends on grade and receptor status far more than on line.

notes.title: Why this split exists
notes.md: GOG-107, GOG-177 and GOG-209 all **excluded prior cytotoxic chemotherapy**. Their recurrent patients were chemo-naive. Reading their medians as salvage-line expectations overestimates what a pretreated patient can expect — GOG-209's own subgroups show median OS of 20.4–22.0 months in measurable/recurrent patients versus 113 months in the non-measurable, non-recurrent group.

notes.title: Reading notes
notes.md:
- **For endometrioid relapse, the MMR result chooses the 2L drug more than the histology does.** dMMR: PD-1 monotherapy is active in endometrioid tumours specifically (GARNET type I ORR 40%; KEYNOTE-158 endometrial 57%). pMMR: lenvatinib/pembrolizumab, or hormonal therapy if the tumour is low-grade and receptor-positive.
- **Hormonal therapy is a real option here, not filler** (the serous note leaves it out for good reason). Response tracks grade and PR: GOG-81 grade 1 ORR 37% vs grade 3 9%. The everolimus/letrozole data show the same split — endometrioid responds, serous does not. GOG-3007's 28-month PFS in chemo-naive patients is from a small subset of a 74-patient phase II.
- **Single-agent tamoxifen is weak** (ORR 10%; endometrioid 1/27). It is only used alternating with a progestin (GOG-3007 MT arm).
- **CTNNB1 recurs as a signal** (bevacizumab in GOG-86P; everolimus/letrozole in Slomovitz 2015). It is an NSMP-endometrioid feature, but the numbers are too small to act on.
- The platinum-re-treatment row stays ⚠️: widely used practice that rests on extrapolation across the 3A/3B boundary.
